BiblicalUsage: Shillem is the youngest son of Naphtali, named in the family that goes down into Egypt. His sons are counted as the Shilemite family in the wilderness census.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the youngest son is counted with the rest, and the family that bears his name is still standing at the census.
RelatedPeople: Shillem; Naphtali; Joseph, Son of Jacob
